corrections.text: The article quotes 9to5Google as writing, "Google has delayed the launch of Gemini 3.5 Pro beyond its originally promised June timeline." This exact sentence does not appear in the cited 9to5Google article. The underlying fact is accurate and corroborated by both 9to5Google ("That deadline has passed with no update on when to expect it") and PYMNTS ("Google is months behind schedule"), but it should not have been presented as a direct quotation from 9to5Google.

The article quotes Investing.com as attributing part of the delay to Google's "complex organizational structure—requiring multiple stakeholder approvals and cross-product integration across Search, Maps, and YouTube." Investing.com's actual wording is: "Google's structure—with multiple layers of stakeholders involved in preparing models for release and working to integrate AI across a vast product portfolio including Search, Maps, and YouTube—can cause delays." The substance is accurate; the article's version is a paraphrase, not a verbatim quote.
